blueprint.title: NVR Paper — GL Standard Style

sections.instructions: This section shows shape patterns in a row. Work out how the pattern grows, then pick the shape that comes next. There are five answers each time. A worked example starts the section — read it first. If one feels hard, move on and come back.

This section is about shape pairs. The first two shapes go together in a certain way. Work out the way. Then pick the shape that pairs with the third one just like that. Read the worked example first.

This section shows groups of shapes. Most of them belong together in one way. Find the one that does not belong. The worked example shows you how. A blank scores nothing, so a careful guess beats no answer.

This section uses letter codes for shapes. Each letter stands for one thing about a shape. A fresh code applies to every question, so read each one from the start. The worked example shows how a code fits together.

blueprint.notes: Authored FROM corpus evidence (SCP-NVR-1, decisions entry 1): GL NVR = 4x20 sections from the six-pool {series, analogy, like-classification, odd-classification, matrix, codes}, codes in every paper, always 5 options, worked example + practice per section, separate sheet. This draft fixes one representative 4-of-6; 3D/reflection-as-task never appears in GL blueprints (SCP-NVR-3). ~10 min per 20q. Types are forward refs to the NVR registry.
